# 花蓮
```{r}
library(data.table)

# ============================================================
# 1. 路徑與基本設定
# ============================================================

folder_path = "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/花蓮縣"

output_path = paste0(
  "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/",
  "期末data/花蓮縣公車.csv"
)

date_col = "資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)"

# ============================================================
# 2. 只指定需要的 4 個檔案
# ============================================================

file_list = file.path(
  folder_path,
  c(
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_2024.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202509.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202510_to_202601.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202601_to_202606.csv"
  )
)

# 檢查檔案是否存在
missing_files = file_list[!file.exists(file_list)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到以下檔案：\n",
      paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
    )
  )
}

print(basename(file_list))

# ============================================================
# 3. 逐檔讀取與處理
# ============================================================

dt_list = lapply(
  file_list,
  function(f) {

    file_name = basename(f)

    cat("\n正在讀取：", file_name, "\n")

    dt = fread(
      f,
      fill = TRUE,
      showProgress = TRUE
    )

    # 如果每個原始檔第一列確實是多餘資料，才保留
    dt = dt[-1]

    # 檢查日期欄位
    if (!(date_col %in% names(dt))) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          file_name,
          " 缺少日期欄位：",
          date_col
        )
      )
    }

    # 日期轉換
    dt[, (date_col) := as.IDate(get(date_col))]

    # 排除無法轉換成日期的資料
    dt = dt[
      !is.na(get(date_col))
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 各檔案只保留其正確日期範圍
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (grepl("_2024\\.csv$", file_name)) {

      dt = dt[
        get(date_col) >= as.IDate("2024-01-01") &
          get(date_col) <= as.IDate("2024-12-31")
      ]

    } else if (grepl("_202509\\.csv$", file_name)) {

      dt = dt[
        get(date_col) >= as.IDate("2025-01-01") &
          get(date_col) <= as.IDate("2025-09-30")
      ]

    } else if (
      grepl("_202510_to_202601\\.csv$", file_name)
    ) {

      # 舊檔只保留 2025 年 10–12 月
      # 移除其中重複的 2026 年 1 月
      dt = dt[
        get(date_col) >= as.IDate("2025-10-01") &
          get(date_col) <= as.IDate("2025-12-31")
      ]

    } else if (
      grepl("_202601_to_202606\\.csv$", file_name)
    ) {

      # 2026 年 1–6 月使用最新檔案
      dt = dt[
        get(date_col) >= as.IDate("2026-01-01") &
          get(date_col) <= as.IDate("2026-06-30")
      ]
    }

    dt
  }
)

# ============================================================
# 4. 合併
# ============================================================

temp = rbindlist(
  dt_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 5. 刪除不必要欄位
# ============================================================

drop_cols = c(
  "所屬業管機關",
  "來源端平台資料更新時間(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)",
  "本平台資料更新時間(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)"
)

existing_drop_cols = intersect(
  drop_cols,
  names(temp)
)

if (length(existing_drop_cols) > 0) {
  temp[, (existing_drop_cols) := NULL]
}

# ============================================================
# 6. 整理最終資料
# ============================================================

# 移除完全相同的重複列
temp = unique(temp)

# 依日期排序
setorder(
  temp,
  `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
)

final = temp

# ============================================================
# 7. 輸出
# ============================================================

fwrite(
  final,
  output_path,
  bom = TRUE
)

cat("\n資料處理完成\n")
cat("輸出位置：", output_path, "\n")
cat("總筆數：", nrow(final), "\n")

head(final)
```


## check
```{r}
library(data.table)

# ============================================================
# 1. 路徑與日期欄位
# ============================================================

folder_path = "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/花蓮縣"

merged_path = paste0(
  "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/",
  "期末data/花蓮縣公車.csv"
)

date_col = "資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)"

# ============================================================
# 2. 定義原始檔案與實際採用日期範圍
# ============================================================

file_period = data.table(
  file_name = c(
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_2024.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202509.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202510_to_202601.csv",
    "花蓮縣公車電子票證資料_202601_to_202606.csv"
  ),
  start_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-01-01",
    "2025-01-01",
    "2025-10-01",
    "2026-01-01"
  )),
  end_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-12-31",
    "2025-09-30",
    "2025-12-31",
    "2026-06-30"
  ))
)

file_period[
  ,
  file_path := file.path(folder_path, file_name)
]

# ============================================================
# 3. 檢查檔案是否存在
# ============================================================

missing_original_files = file_period[
  !file.exists(file_path),
  file_path
]

if (length(missing_original_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到以下原始檔案：\n",
      paste(missing_original_files, collapse = "\n")
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(merged_path)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到合併檔：\n",
      merged_path
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 4. 讀取合併檔日期
# ============================================================

merged_data = fread(
  merged_path,
  select = date_col,
  colClasses = "character",
  showProgress = TRUE
)

# 先轉成文字並移除前後空白
merged_data[
  ,
  (date_col) := trimws(as.character(get(date_col)))
]

# 只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 格式
merged_data = merged_data[
  grepl(
    "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
    get(date_col)
  )
]

# 再轉成日期
merged_data[
  ,
  (date_col) := as.IDate(
    get(date_col),
    format = "%Y-%m-%d"
  )
]

merged_have_days = sort(
  unique(
    merged_data[
      !is.na(get(date_col)),
      get(date_col)
    ]
  )
)

rm(merged_data)
gc()

# ============================================================
# 5. 逐一比較原始檔與合併檔
# ============================================================

comparison_list = list()
difference_list = list()
missing_date_list = list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_period))) {

  file_name = file_period$file_name[i]
  file_path = file_period$file_path[i]
  start_date = file_period$start_date[i]
  end_date = file_period$end_date[i]

  cat("\n正在比較：", file_name, "\n")

  original = fread(
    file_path,
    select = date_col,
    colClasses = "character",
    fill = TRUE,
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  # 先轉成文字並移除空白
  original[
    ,
    (date_col) := trimws(as.character(get(date_col)))
  ]

  # 只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 格式
  original = original[
    grepl(
      "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
      get(date_col)
    )
  ]

  # 再轉成日期
  original[
    ,
    (date_col) := as.IDate(
      get(date_col),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ]

  # 只保留該原始檔實際採用的日期範圍
  original = original[
    !is.na(get(date_col)) &
      get(date_col) >= start_date &
      get(date_col) <= end_date
  ]

  original_have_days = sort(
    unique(
      original[
        ,
        get(date_col)
      ]
    )
  )

  # 理論完整日期
  expected_days = seq(
    start_date,
    end_date,
    by = "day"
  )

  # 原始檔缺少日期
  original_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    original_have_days
  )

  # 合併檔在相同期間存在日期
  merged_have_period = merged_have_days[
    merged_have_days >= start_date &
      merged_have_days <= end_date
  ]

  # 合併檔缺少日期
  merged_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 日期是否完全一致
  same_have_dates = identical(
    sort(original_have_days),
    sort(merged_have_period)
  )

  same_missing_dates = identical(
    sort(original_missing_days),
    sort(merged_missing_days)
  )

  # 原始檔有，但合併檔沒有
  lost_after_merge = setdiff(
    original_have_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 合併檔有，但原始檔沒有
  added_after_merge = setdiff(
    merged_have_period,
    original_have_days
  )

  comparison_list[[file_name]] = data.table(
    檔案名稱 = file_name,
    起始日期 = start_date,
    結束日期 = end_date,
    理論日期數 = length(expected_days),
    原始檔存在日期數 = length(original_have_days),
    合併檔存在日期數 = length(merged_have_period),
    原始檔缺少日期數 = length(original_missing_days),
    合併檔缺少日期數 = length(merged_missing_days),
    存在日期是否完全相同 = same_have_dates,
    缺少日期天數是否相同 =
      length(original_missing_days) ==
      length(merged_missing_days),
    缺少日期是否完全相同 = same_missing_dates,
    合併後遺失日期數 = length(lost_after_merge),
    合併後新增日期數 = length(added_after_merge)
  )

  if (length(lost_after_merge) > 0) {
    difference_list[[paste0(file_name, "_lost")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = lost_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "原始檔有，但合併檔沒有"
    )
  }

  if (length(added_after_merge) > 0) {
    difference_list[[paste0(file_name, "_added")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = added_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "合併檔有，但原始檔沒有"
    )
  }

  if (length(original_missing_days) > 0) {
    missing_date_list[[paste0(file_name, "_original")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = original_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "原始檔缺少"
    )
  }

  if (length(merged_missing_days) > 0) {
    missing_date_list[[paste0(file_name, "_merged")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = merged_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "合併檔缺少"
    )
  }

  rm(original)
  gc()
}

# ============================================================
# 6. 顯示比較結果
# ============================================================

comparison_result = rbindlist(
  comparison_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

comparison_result
```

```{r}
file_list = file.path(

print(basename(file_list))

# ============================================================

dt_list = lapply(
  file_list,
  function(f) {

    file_name = basename(f)

    cat("\n正在讀取：", file_name, "\n")

    dt = fread(

    dt[

      )

        get(date_col) >= as.IDate("2026-01-01") &
```

## check
```{r}
library(data.table)

# ============================================================
# 1. 路徑與日期欄位
# ============================================================

folder_path = "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/臺東縣"

merged_path = paste0(
  "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/",
  "期末data/臺東縣公車.csv"
)

date_col = "資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)"

# ============================================================
# 2. 定義原始檔案與實際使用日期範圍
# ============================================================

file_period = data.table(
  file_name = c(
    "臺東縣公車電子票證資料_2024.csv",
    "臺東縣公車電子票證資料_202507.csv",
    "臺東縣公車電子票證資料_202508_to_09.csv",
    "臺東縣公車電子票證資料_202510_to_202601.csv",
    "臺東縣公車電子票證資料_202601_to_202606.csv"
  ),
  start_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-01-01",
    "2025-01-01",
    "2025-08-01",
    "2025-10-01",
    "2026-01-01"
  )),
  end_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-12-31",
    "2025-07-31",
    "2025-09-30",
    "2025-12-31",
    "2026-06-30"
  ))
)

file_period[
  ,
  file_path := file.path(folder_path, file_name)
]

# ============================================================
# 3. 檢查檔案是否存在
# ============================================================

missing_original_files = file_period[
  !file.exists(file_path),
  file_path
]

if (length(missing_original_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到以下原始檔案：\n",
      paste(missing_original_files, collapse = "\n")
    )
  )
}

if (!file.exists(merged_path)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到合併檔：\n",
      merged_path
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 4. 日期清理函數
# ============================================================

clean_date_column = function(dt, date_col) {

  if (!(date_col %in% names(dt))) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "資料中找不到日期欄位：",
        date_col
      )
    )
  }

  # 轉成文字並移除前後空白
  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := trimws(as.character(get(date_col)))
  ]

  # 只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 格式
  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col)) &
      grepl(
        "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
        get(date_col)
      )
  ]

  # 轉成 IDate
  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := as.IDate(
      get(date_col),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ]

  # 排除例如 2025-13-40 之類的無效日期
  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col))
  ]

  dt
}

# ============================================================
# 5. 讀取合併檔的日期
# ============================================================

cat("\n正在讀取合併檔日期\n")

merged_data = fread(
  merged_path,
  select = date_col,
  colClasses = "character",
  showProgress = TRUE
)

merged_data = clean_date_column(
  merged_data,
  date_col
)

merged_have_days = sort(
  unique(
    merged_data[
      ,
      get(date_col)
    ]
  )
)

rm(merged_data)
gc()

# ============================================================
# 6. 比較各原始檔與合併檔
# ============================================================

comparison_list = list()
difference_list = list()
missing_date_list = list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_period))) {

  file_name = file_period$file_name[i]
  file_path = file_period$file_path[i]
  start_date = file_period$start_date[i]
  end_date = file_period$end_date[i]

  cat("\n正在比較：", file_name, "\n")

  # 只讀取日期欄位
  original = fread(
    file_path,
    select = date_col,
    colClasses = "character",
    fill = TRUE,
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  original = clean_date_column(
    original,
    date_col
  )

  # 只保留合併時實際採用的日期範圍
  original = original[
    get(date_col) >= start_date &
      get(date_col) <= end_date
  ]

  # 原始檔實際存在日期
  original_have_days = sort(
    unique(
      original[
        ,
        get(date_col)
      ]
    )
  )

  # 理論上應存在的完整日期
  expected_days = seq(
    start_date,
    end_date,
    by = "day"
  )

  # 原始檔缺少日期
  original_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    original_have_days
  )

  # 合併檔在同一期間存在日期
  merged_have_period = merged_have_days[
    merged_have_days >= start_date &
      merged_have_days <= end_date
  ]

  # 合併檔在同一期間缺少日期
  merged_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 日期集合是否完全一致
  same_have_dates = identical(
    sort(original_have_days),
    sort(merged_have_period)
  )

  # 缺少日期是否完全一致
  same_missing_dates = identical(
    sort(original_missing_days),
    sort(merged_missing_days)
  )

  # 原始檔有，但合併檔沒有
  lost_after_merge = setdiff(
    original_have_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 合併檔有，但該原始檔沒有
  added_after_merge = setdiff(
    merged_have_period,
    original_have_days
  )

  comparison_list[[file_name]] = data.table(
    檔案名稱 = file_name,
    起始日期 = start_date,
    結束日期 = end_date,
    理論日期數 = length(expected_days),
    原始檔存在日期數 = length(original_have_days),
    合併檔存在日期數 = length(merged_have_period),
    原始檔缺少日期數 = length(original_missing_days),
    合併檔缺少日期數 = length(merged_missing_days),
    存在日期是否完全相同 = same_have_dates,
    缺少日期天數是否相同 =
      length(original_missing_days) ==
      length(merged_missing_days),
    缺少日期是否完全相同 = same_missing_dates,
    合併後遺失日期數 = length(lost_after_merge),
    合併後新增日期數 = length(added_after_merge)
  )

  # 原始檔有，但合併檔沒有
  if (length(lost_after_merge) > 0) {
    difference_list[[paste0(file_name, "_lost")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = lost_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "原始檔有，但合併檔沒有"
    )
  }

  # 合併檔有，但原始檔沒有
  if (length(added_after_merge) > 0) {
    difference_list[[paste0(file_name, "_added")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = added_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "合併檔有，但原始檔沒有"
    )
  }

  # 記錄原始檔缺少日期
  if (length(original_missing_days) > 0) {
    missing_date_list[[paste0(file_name, "_original")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = original_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "原始檔缺少"
    )
  }

  # 記錄合併檔缺少日期
  if (length(merged_missing_days) > 0) {
    missing_date_list[[paste0(file_name, "_merged")]] = data.table(
      檔案名稱 = file_name,
      日期 = merged_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "合併檔缺少"
    )
  }

  rm(original)
  gc()
}

# ============================================================
# 7. 顯示比較摘要
# ============================================================

comparison_result = rbindlist(
  comparison_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

comparison_result
```

# 公路客運
```{r}
library(data.table)

# ============================================================
# 1. 路徑與篩選設定
# ============================================================

folder_path = "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/公路客運"

output_folder = "C:/Users/user/Desktop/運籌/115/票證資料/期末data"

final_output = file.path(
  output_folder,
  "公路客運2024_to_202606.csv"
)

date_col = "資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)"

keep_operators = c(
  "0805",
  "0816",
  "1201",
  "1602",
  "1308"
)

drop_routes = c(
  "1356",
  "1657",
  "1661",
  "1662",
  "1665",
  "1666",
  "1915"
)

drop_cols = c(
  "所屬業管機關",
  "來源端平台資料更新時間(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)",
  "本平台資料更新時間(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)"
)

# 如果輸出資料夾不存在則建立
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(
    output_folder,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 2. 只指定需要的四個檔案
# ============================================================

file_info = data.table(
  file_name = c(
    "公路客運電子票證資料_2024.csv",
    "公路客運電子票證資料_202509.csv",
    "公路客運電子票證資料_202510_to_202601.csv",
    "公路客運電子票證資料_202601_to_202606.csv"
  ),
  start_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-01-01",
    "2025-01-01",
    "2025-10-01",
    "2026-01-01"
  )),
  end_date = as.IDate(c(
    "2024-12-31",
    "2025-09-30",
    "2025-12-31",
    "2026-06-30"
  ))
)

file_info[
  ,
  file_path := file.path(
    folder_path,
    file_name
  )
]

# 檢查檔案是否存在
missing_files = file_info[
  !file.exists(file_path),
  file_path
]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "找不到以下檔案：\n",
      paste(
        missing_files,
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  )
}

print(file_info[, .(
  檔案名稱 = file_name,
  開始日期 = start_date,
  結束日期 = end_date
)])

# ============================================================
# 3. 清理欄位名稱函數
# ============================================================

clean_column_names = function(dt) {

  new_names = names(dt)

  # 移除 BOM
  new_names = sub(
    "^\ufeff",
    "",
    new_names
  )

  # 移除欄名前後空白
  new_names = trimws(new_names)

  # 避免重複欄名
  new_names = make.unique(
    new_names,
    sep = "_duplicate_"
  )

  # 依位置重新命名
  setnames(
    dt,
    new_names
  )

  dt
}

# ============================================================
# 4. 共用處理函數
# ============================================================

process_bus_file = function(
  input_file,
  start_date,
  end_date
) {

  file_name = basename(input_file)

  cat(
    "\n正在處理：",
    file_name,
    "\n"
  )

  dt = fread(
    input_file,
    fill = TRUE,
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  original_n = nrow(dt)

  # 清理欄名
  dt = clean_column_names(dt)

  required_cols = c(
    "業者編號",
    "搭乘路線名稱",
    date_col
  )

  missing_cols = setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(dt)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        file_name,
        " 缺少必要欄位：",
        paste(
          missing_cols,
          collapse = "、"
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 統一必要欄位型態
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dt[
    ,
    業者編號 := trimws(
      as.character(業者編號)
    )
  ]

  dt[
    ,
    搭乘路線名稱 := trimws(
      as.character(搭乘路線名稱)
    )
  ]

  if ("上車站牌代碼" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[
      ,
      上車站牌代碼 := as.character(
        上車站牌代碼
      )
    ]
  }

  if ("下車站牌代碼" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[
      ,
      下車站牌代碼 := as.character(
        下車站牌代碼
      )
    ]
  }

  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := trimws(
      as.character(get(date_col))
    )
  ]

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 刪除英文欄名列
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dt = dt[
    !is.na(業者編號) &
      業者編號 != "OperatorNo"
  ]

  after_header_n = nrow(dt)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 清理並轉換日期
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  # 只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 格式，避免 charToDate 錯誤
  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col)) &
      grepl(
        "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
        get(date_col)
      )
  ]

  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := as.IDate(
      get(date_col),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ]

  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col))
  ]

  # 僅保留該檔案實際使用的期間
  dt = dt[
    get(date_col) >= start_date &
      get(date_col) <= end_date
  ]

  after_date_n = nrow(dt)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 保留指定業者
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dt = dt[
    業者編號 %chin% keep_operators
  ]

  after_operator_n = nrow(dt)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 排除指定路線
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dt = dt[
    is.na(搭乘路線名稱) |
      !搭乘路線名稱 %chin% drop_routes
  ]

  after_route_n = nrow(dt)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 刪除不必要欄位
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  existing_drop_cols = intersect(
    drop_cols,
    names(dt)
  )

  if (length(existing_drop_cols) > 0) {
    dt[
      ,
      (existing_drop_cols) := NULL
    ]
  }

  # 依日期排序
  setorder(
    dt,
    `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
  )

  summary = data.table(
    檔案名稱 = file_name,
    原始筆數 = original_n,
    刪除英文欄名後筆數 = after_header_n,
    日期篩選後筆數 = after_date_n,
    業者篩選後筆數 = after_operator_n,
    路線篩選後筆數 = after_route_n
  )

  list(
    data = dt,
    summary = summary
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 5. 處理四個檔案
# ============================================================

result_list = vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = nrow(file_info)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_info))) {

  result_list[[i]] = process_bus_file(
    input_file = file_info$file_path[i],
    start_date = file_info$start_date[i],
    end_date = file_info$end_date[i]
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 6. 取出各檔處理後資料
# ============================================================

data_2024 = result_list[[1]]$data
data_2025_01_to_09 = result_list[[2]]$data
data_2025_10_to_12 = result_list[[3]]$data
data_2026 = result_list[[4]]$data

# 合併 2025 年兩個區段
data_2025 = rbindlist(
  list(
    data_2025_01_to_09,
    data_2025_10_to_12
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

setorder(
  data_2025,
  `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
)

# ============================================================
# 7. 合併 2024 至 2026 年 6 月
# ============================================================

final = rbindlist(
  list(
    data_2024,
    data_2025,
    data_2026
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# 移除完全相同的重複資料列
final = unique(final)

# 依日期排序
setorder(
  final,
  `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
)

# ============================================================
# 8. 輸出各年度整理檔
# ============================================================

fwrite(
  data_2024,
  file.path(
    output_folder,
    "公路客運2024.csv"
  ),
  bom = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  data_2025,
  file.path(
    output_folder,
    "公路客運2025.csv"
  ),
  bom = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  data_2026,
  file.path(
    output_folder,
    "公路客運2026.csv"
  ),
  bom = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 9. 輸出完整合併檔
# ============================================================

fwrite(
  final,
  final_output,
  bom = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 10. 顯示處理摘要
# ============================================================

process_summary = rbindlist(
  lapply(
    result_list,
    function(x) x$summary
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

process_summary

cat("\n全部處理完成\n")
cat("合併檔位置：", final_output, "\n")
cat("總筆數：", nrow(final), "\n")
cat(
  "日期範圍：",
  as.character(
    min(
      final[[date_col]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
  "至",
  as.character(
    max(
      final[[date_col]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
  "\n"
)

head(final)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

clean_date_data = function(dt, date_col) {

  if (!(date_col %in% names(dt))) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "找不到日期欄位：",
        date_col
      )
    )
  }

  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := trimws(
      as.character(get(date_col))
    )
  ]

  # 只保留 YYYY-MM-DD 格式
  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col)) &
      grepl(
        "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
        get(date_col)
      )
  ]

  dt[
    ,
    (date_col) := as.IDate(
      get(date_col),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ]

  dt = dt[
    !is.na(get(date_col))
  ]

  dt
}

# ============================================================
# 5. 讀取合併檔日期
# ============================================================

cat("\n正在讀取合併檔日期：\n")
cat(merged_path, "\n")

merged_data = fread(
  merged_path,
  select = date_col,
  colClasses = "character",
  fill = TRUE,

)

)

    ]
  )
)

  "\n"
)

cat(
  "合併檔實際日期數：",
  length(merged_have_days),
  "\n"
)

rm(merged_data)
gc()

# ============================================================
# 6. 逐一比較年度檔與合併檔
# ============================================================

comparison_list = list()
difference_list = list()
missing_date_list = list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(file_period))) {

  year_value = file_period$year[i]
  file_name = file_period$file_name[i]
  file_path = file_period$file_path[i]
  start_date = file_period$start_date[i]
  end_date = file_period$end_date[i]

  cat(
    "\n正在比較：",
    file_name,
    "\n"
  )

  # 只讀取日期欄位
  yearly_data = fread(
    file_path,
    select = date_col,
    colClasses = "character",
    fill = TRUE,
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  yearly_data = clean_date_data(
    yearly_data,
    date_col
  )

  # 僅保留該年度應比較的日期區間
  yearly_data = yearly_data[
    get(date_col) >= start_date &
      get(date_col) <= end_date
  ]

  # 年度檔實際存在日期
  yearly_have_days = sort(
    unique(
      yearly_data[
        ,
        get(date_col)
      ]
    )
  )

  # 理論上應有的日期
  expected_days = seq(
    start_date,
    end_date,
    by = "day"
  )

  # 年度檔缺少日期
  yearly_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    yearly_have_days
  )

  # 合併檔在同一期間存在的日期
  merged_have_period = merged_have_days[
    merged_have_days >= start_date &
      merged_have_days <= end_date
  ]

  # 合併檔在同一期間缺少的日期
  merged_missing_days = setdiff(
    expected_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 年度檔有，但合併檔沒有
  lost_after_merge = setdiff(
    yearly_have_days,
    merged_have_period
  )

  # 合併檔有，但年度檔沒有
  added_after_merge = setdiff(
    merged_have_period,
    yearly_have_days
  )

  # 日期集合是否完全一致
  same_have_dates = identical(
    sort(yearly_have_days),
    sort(merged_have_period)
  )

  # 缺少日期集合是否完全一致
  same_missing_dates = identical(
    sort(yearly_missing_days),
    sort(merged_missing_days)
  )

  comparison_list[[as.character(year_value)]] = data.table(
    年份 = year_value,
    年度檔案 = file_name,
    起始日期 = start_date,
    結束日期 = end_date,
    理論日期數 = length(expected_days),
    年度檔存在日期數 = length(yearly_have_days),
    合併檔存在日期數 = length(merged_have_period),
    年度檔缺少日期數 = length(yearly_missing_days),
    合併檔缺少日期數 = length(merged_missing_days),
    存在日期是否完全相同 = same_have_dates,
    缺少日期天數是否相同 =
      length(yearly_missing_days) ==
      length(merged_missing_days),
    缺少日期是否完全相同 = same_missing_dates,
    合併後遺失日期數 = length(lost_after_merge),
    合併後新增日期數 = length(added_after_merge)
  )

  # 年度檔有，但合併檔沒有
  if (length(lost_after_merge) > 0) {

    difference_list[[paste0(
      year_value,
      "_lost"
    )]] = data.table(
      年份 = year_value,
      日期 = lost_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "年度檔有，但合併檔沒有"
    )
  }

  # 合併檔有，但年度檔沒有
  if (length(added_after_merge) > 0) {

    difference_list[[paste0(
      year_value,
      "_added"
    )]] = data.table(
      年份 = year_value,
      日期 = added_after_merge,
      差異類型 = "合併檔有，但年度檔沒有"
    )
  }

  # 年度檔缺少日期
  if (length(yearly_missing_days) > 0) {

    missing_date_list[[paste0(
      year_value,
      "_yearly"
    )]] = data.table(
      年份 = year_value,
      日期 = yearly_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "年度檔缺少"
    )
  }

  # 合併檔缺少日期
  if (length(merged_missing_days) > 0) {

    missing_date_list[[paste0(
      year_value,
      "_merged"
    )]] = data.table(
      年份 = year_value,
      日期 = merged_missing_days,
      資料來源 = "合併檔缺少"
    )
  }

  rm(yearly_data)
  gc()
}

# ============================================================
# 7. 顯示比較摘要
# ============================================================
```
